title: Training off-VM: GitHub-runner first, Kaggle GPU second; design (T1) then the artefact return path (T2) behind a parity gate
note: [2026-10-14 weekly planning] OPERATOR-APPROVED 2026-10-14. Two phases: (1) Tier-1 DESIGN doc under docs/plans/ -- which manifests can train on a GitHub runner (CPU, 6 h/job) vs a Kaggle GPU kernel (COMPUTE-KAGGLE-GPU passed 2026-10-13: 2x T4, 30 h/wk), how market-only shards reach them (ML-DATA-OFF-TRAINER classification: OURS families never leave the trainer), and a PARITY GATE: an off-VM artefact is admitted only if it matches a trainer-VM run of the same manifest within a declared tolerance on the same eval split. (2) Tier-2 RETURN PATH: the artefact lands in the trainer registry as 'candidate' through the existing promote ladder; needs one operator OK before the first registry write. Runner first because it is free and already authenticated; Kaggle GPU for the manifests the runner cannot fit.

observation.what: (T1) the design doc is on main naming manifests per backend and the parity tolerance; (T2) one off-VM training artefact passes the parity gate against a trainer-VM run of the same manifest and lands as candidate in the registry
observation.how_to_check: docs/plans/ design doc path on this row; python -m ml list-models showing the off-VM candidate with its parity record
